sources.title: M1 — Guided meditation, courses and other content; no paywall, no required account or payment according to vendor.
M2 — AGPL applies to app code, not original audio. Original/partner content remains restricted; external reuse needs separate rights.
M3 — Developer listing documents session choice, playback and downloads; iOS 15+, English. Account-related release notes exist; no-account core does not mean no optional account features.
S1 — App is currently free; email account required; mobile/web access and adult guided activities documented. Statement excludes treatment purpose.
S2 — Adult meditation and learning pathways, content search/filtering, routines and progress; charity-supported free individual access.
S3 — Developer description includes offline downloads. Listing iOS 16.4+, interface English; this AU storefront is not owner-region installation proof.
H1 — Public program entirely free and donor funded; iOS/Android registration required. Separate paid courses/events do not define app entitlement.
H2 — EULA names free donor-funded Public Subscription and distinguishes institutional/Foundations access. Personal license is conditional/revocable; updates may alter features.
H3 — Public program has Awareness/Connection/Insight/Purpose modules; Foundations recommended, moving among modules allowed. Institutional/research configurations may differ.
H4 — Older help article describes preloading identical activity choices for offline use; not a modern full download manager guarantee.
H5 — Older article says English-only and store-available countries with South Korea exception; present owner-store availability requires recheck.
H6 — Older support lists iOS 14+ / most Android 10+. Current App Store lists iOS 13.4+: preserve mismatch, do not choose a universal minimum.
H7 — Current US listing interface English, iOS 13.4+; account region/device not tested.
Owner Android guided meditation playback evidence — PR5.54

candidates.edition: Medito public Android app; signed-in owner sample
candidates.relationship: For personal adult guided meditation, Medito lets you choose a session from its courses and play guided audio, as observed with Learning to sit. This substitutes for selecting and playing a Calm guided meditation; it does not establish equivalent catalog, sleep stories or health outcomes.
candidates.noSubscription: The vendor describes the public app and meditation content as free without a paywall. The signed-in Android owner sample played Learning to sit without a payment request. No mandatory recurring software payment is documented for this bounded public workflow.
candidates.pricingModel: Free public app and meditation content, supported by donations; no paid perpetual license is implied.
candidates.tradeOffSummary: A course-based meditation alternative rather than the complete Calm catalog. Core no-account access is vendor-documented but the owner tested signed in. App code licensing does not grant unrestricted reuse of original or partner audio.

candidates.edition: Smiling Mind free individual adult Android content; Google sign-in
candidates.relationship: For personal adult guided meditation, Smiling Mind lets you select an adult session and play guided audio, as observed with Exploring the Breath. This substitutes for the corresponding Calm selection/playback activity, without implying parity with Calm sleep stories, music or its entire catalog.
candidates.noSubscription: Official material describes the individual app as currently free. The Android owner sample selected Exploring the Breath and played, paused and resumed it without a payment, trial or subscription request. No mandatory recurring software payment is documented for this bounded workflow.
candidates.pricingModel: Currently free individual access supported by the nonprofit; a registered account is required. This is not a perpetual-access guarantee.
candidates.tradeOffSummary: A broader mental-fitness app with adult, family and other sections; the comparison covers adult guided sessions only. Account registration is required. Download features are documented but offline playback was not tested.

candidates.edition: Healthy Minds donor-funded public program on Android; exclude institutional/research contracts
candidates.relationship: For personal adult guided meditation, the Healthy Minds public program lets you choose and play a guided practice, as observed with Intro To Sitting Meditation. This substitutes for Calm guided-session selection and playback within a structured learning program, not for every Calm content category.
candidates.noSubscription: Official material describes the donor-funded public program as entirely free. The owner sample played, paused and resumed a guided sitting practice without a payment request. The EULA term Public Subscription describes free public access, not evidence of mandatory recurring payment; institutional arrangements are excluded.
candidates.pricingModel: Free donor-funded public access with registration; donations are optional. Separate paid courses, workplace or research agreements are outside this edition.
candidates.tradeOffSummary: A structured Awareness, Connection, Insight and Purpose program rather than the complete Calm catalog. Registration is required. Older offline instructions and conflicting documented iOS requirements remain limitations; the Android sample does not resolve them.

description: Alternatives for selecting and playing personal adult guided meditations without mandatory recurring software payment. Reviewed public editions only; accounts and service limits apply. Calm also has limited free access. No clinical, offline or full-catalog equivalence.
editorialDecision: Accept documentary and owner evidence for bounded draft claims at 0.85 confidence; unknown versions/store/audio language limit reproducibility, not proof of indefinite access. Dated 2026-10-15 editorial review uses preserved 2026-10-14 sources, not new live verification.
limits: Unobserved version, anonymous access or trial entitlement
metadata: Android OS, app versions, device/storefront and audio language remain unknown. Sample-specific evidence is valid as observed, but no current-version/general-region guarantee follows.
